checked.how: Opened both. The NEW BEST chip is mustard with ink text and an ink outline and shadow. It is right-aligned in the top-right timer stack, directly under the BEST chip. BEST is z-index 1, so BEST's 3px shadow overlaps the chip's missing top edge. TIME and PAUSE do not move. The label reads NEW BEST in caps at label size. This matches board 05: 'chip slides out from under the timer'.

Same layout as at 844. Desktop scaling is B05 (#24), which is still in flight, so phone size is expected per the spec's plan audit. The chip stays in the corner stack and out of the centre clear zone.

The chip label reads 'NEW BEST LAP' over '0:40.37', exactly as in the mockup (caps via ui-label). It uses the same mustard panel as before. results-screen.ts:318 only switches the text between 'New best lap' and 'Best lap'.

Checked for literals by reading every new declaration. Values come from var(--space-s1/s2), var(--radius-rect), var(--duration-slide) and var(--ease-snap); the rest are translateY(-100%), line-height 1, isolation and z-index 1. No hex, rgb, px or font literals. No opacity, gradient, filter or blur. Only transform and visibility animate.

Under prefers-reduced-motion, transitions are off for is-out and is-back, and is-back is visibility:hidden. The chip just cuts, as UI_RULES §7 and board 05 require ('turn every other move into a cut').

Radius is 0 0 var(--radius-rect) var(--radius-rect) with border-top 0, copied exactly from .ui-hud-best (hud.css:116-125). It inherits the .ui-panel outline and the --shadow-hud tier (components.css:72-76), the same component as BEST, following UI_RULES §10 ('copy an existing component exactly') and the plan audit.

Durations come from tokens.motion.durationMs.slide. The 2000ms hold is board 05's 'holds 2s'; tokens.json:77 has no hold token (Grep 'hold|2000' found only durationMs). Slide-back ends at the GONE tick (BACK + 12 ticks = 200ms), so visibility is cut only after the slide finishes.
